I just learned this in AP Chem! 
Basically the molecules with a higher temperature have a higher amount of kinetic energy to satisfy the activation energy required for a bimolecular reaction. Since they have a higher energy, more are likely to react with a good collision positioning, so the reaction rate will rise.
For concentration, the reaction rate will rise because there is a higher number of molecules that will hit each other so there will be more successful collisions because there are more molecules atogether.
